popular.title: Wildwood
popular.plot: A young girl and her classmate enter a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries. They face a desperate quest to rescue her abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman.

popular.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
popular.plot: A full-time crimefighter protects a city that has forgotten who he is, while watching people from his past move on without him. As loneliness and strange changes in his abilities add to the pressure, he must face a dangerous new threat that puts the city and those he cares about at risk.

popular.title: Hope
popular.plot: In a remote South Korean harbor village, a police chief and his officers investigate a mysterious creature causing destruction in the community. As the threat grows, confusion and human conflict make it increasingly difficult for the residents to understand what they are facing.

popular.title: The Dark Knight
popular.plot: As a masked crime fighter and his allies work to dismantle Gotham’s criminal organizations, the city begins to see a fragile path toward justice. Their efforts are challenged by a dangerous criminal mastermind whose campaign of chaos tests the limits of their partnership and their beliefs.

popular.title: Drive - The Pretenders
popular.plot: A young race car mechanic fakes an engagement to a notorious racing star, hoping to improve his reputation while secretly pursuing her own chance to race. As the pretense continues, it puts both their ambitions and the growing connection between them at risk.

popular.title: Clayface
popular.plot: A young man rises from the streets of Gotham to become a Hollywood star, but a crime boss’s actions leave him disfigured and abandoned. Desperate for help, he undergoes a treatment that restores his appearance while unsettling his sense of reality, setting him on a destructive path.

popular.title: The Odyssey
popular.plot: After the Trojan War, a legendary king sets out on a perilous journey home. He faces divine interference, mythological creatures, and trials that test his cleverness and humanity, while those waiting for him at home face troubles of their own.

popular.title: The Dog Stars
popular.plot: In a world devastated by a pandemic, a solitary pilot makes a home in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a guarded gunman. When a mysterious radio transmission reaches him during a flight, he sets out to discover where it came from, confronting the dangers and uncertainties of life among the survivors.

popular.title: Buddy
popular.plot: A magical orange unicorn hosts a children’s television show while holding its young cast captive inside a surreal world. As the cheerful lessons grow increasingly disturbing, the children begin questioning their reality and searching for a way to survive their demented host.

popular.title: Matchbox: The Movie
popular.plot: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

popular.title: Verity
popular.plot: A struggling writer takes a ghostwriting job for a bestselling novelist who is unable to work after an accident. While staying at the novelist’s home to study her notes, she discovers unsettling material and begins to question what is happening within the household.

popular.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
popular.plot: A young mother raising her daughter in her childhood home discovers she can enter a mysterious realm called the Further. There, she has an unusual ability to bring its inhabitants into the real world, drawing her into a frightening struggle to protect her family.

popular.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
popular.plot: During a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground. Surrounded by dizzying heights and exposed, dangerous paths, they face increasingly difficult odds and must fight to survive with little room for error.

popular.title: Pinocchio: Unstrung
popular.plot: Created by a toymaker and influenced by a sinister cricket, a wooden puppet sets out on a violent quest to become a real boy. His path is tied to a brother who already has what he wants, driving a dark reimagining of a familiar fairy tale.

popular.title: The Awakening
popular.plot: An elite military unit enters a South American jungle to eliminate an enemy target, but the mission becomes a fight for survival when supernatural forces emerge. Centuries earlier, another expedition vanished in the same territory, where a hidden ancient presence still resists anyone seeking control.

popular.title: Masterplan
popular.plot: A legendary thief recruits two young strangers to help steal a famous painting, then reveals an unexpected family connection. Thrust into a chaotic reunion, the new family must learn to work together—and tolerate one another—if they hope to pull off an ambitious heist.

popular.title: Resident Evil
popular.plot: A medical courier is caught in a terrifying outbreak during one chaotic night and must fight to survive as danger closes in. Far from a trained action hero, he faces increasingly frightening encounters while trying to make his way through the crisis.

popular.title: Forgotten Island
popular.plot: Two high school graduates and best friends are transported through a mysterious portal to a fantastical island filled with magical creatures. To find their way home, they must face a difficult cost tied to the memories that bind them, while seeking help and a way to leave before their friendship slips away.

popular.title: The Nightmare Before Christmas
popular.plot: A weary Halloween figure discovers the wonders of Christmas and decides to bring the holiday’s cheer to a world built around scares. As the unusual plan takes shape, a thoughtful rag-doll companion worries about its consequences and tries to set things right.

popular.title: The Fix
popular.plot: Disillusioned after the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, battle-worn former intelligence operatives head to Tehran to pursue a score that could change their lives. As they try to make it happen, they also grapple with past mistakes and the desire to make amends.

upcoming.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
upcoming.plot: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

upcoming.title: Club Kid
upcoming.plot: A washed-up underground party promoter suddenly faces a major change when he’s forced to care for a son he never knew he had. As his new responsibilities collide with his old lifestyle, everyday choices become a high-stakes test of what he wants next.

upcoming.title: The Last Temptation of Becky
upcoming.plot: Now working as a field agent for the CIA, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf's Lair, Hitler's WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

upcoming.title: Being Heumann
upcoming.plot: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

upcoming.title: The Invisible Guest
upcoming.plot: Accused of murdering her lover, a young businesswoman hires a brilliant lawyer to defend her. With only three hours left, they must work together to uncover what really happened and piece together the truth behind the accusation before time runs out.

upcoming.title: Mouse
upcoming.plot: At the start of the summer before senior year, a teenager’s close relationship with her best friend is suddenly upended. Without that friendship, she feels lost and begins forming an increasingly complicated connection with the friend’s mother.

upcoming.title: The Liberation
upcoming.plot: Rita is entranced by the mesmeric Leader and renounces her family to embrace the world of the enigmatic Harmonia commune. Her daughters Ella and Jo put everything on the line to infiltrate the cult and bring their mother home. Yet, once immersed in the commune, they find themselves inexorably drawn into the Leader’s labyrinthine web of psycho-spiritual manipulation.

upcoming.title: I Play Rocky
upcoming.plot: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

upcoming.title: Nuisance Bear
upcoming.plot: A polar bear struggles to survive as its ancient migration brings it into contact with tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters. As people label the sacred predator a nuisance, the film explores who belongs in a landscape shared by humans and wildlife.

upcoming.title: Zi
upcoming.plot: In Hong Kong, a young woman troubled by visions of her future self encounters a stranger who alters the direction of her night. Their meeting opens the possibility of change, as she faces an uncertain path and questions what may still lie ahead.

upcoming.title: Djinn Wedding
upcoming.plot: Four estranged siblings return to their remote Anatolian village for their sister’s wedding, where buried memories and family secrets resurface. As the celebration unfolds, two siblings reconnect with a bond from their past, prompting a reflective journey through grief, tradition, and the ties linking generations.

upcoming.title: Victorian Psycho
upcoming.plot: An eccentric young governess arrives at a remote Gothic manor, where a string of unsettling events leads the household to question her identity. As suspicion grows, the truth appears more dangerous than anyone expects, placing the residents in an increasingly disturbing situation.

upcoming.title: Confession
upcoming.plot: In 1938, in Stalin's Moscow, a disillusioned professor, Alexei, faces brutal interrogation by his former student, Vladimir, in Lubyanka Prison. Refusing to confess, he confronts his past sins and finds redemption through faith, sacrificing himself to save others in a haunting tale of morality and resistance.

upcoming.title: DreamQuil
upcoming.plot: In a near future where poor air quality forces people into virtual lives, a dissatisfied mother joins a digital wellness retreat, only to return home and discover that a robotic replacement has taken her place, leading to a sinister mystery.

upcoming.title: Eternal Return
upcoming.plot: After losing someone she deeply loved, a young woman becomes emotionally closed off and abandons her former dreams. A chance meeting with a cartographer introduces her to magical maps connected to meaningful moments, prompting a journey through memory, loss, and the possibility of opening her heart again.

upcoming.title: Unbroken: The Untold Story of Shen Yun
upcoming.plot: A classical Chinese dance company rises from modest beginnings to international stages while facing intimidation, smear campaigns, and threats of violence. Through performers’ personal stories, the film explores how demanding training, spiritual conviction, community, and cultural revival sustain artists when their work collides with political pressure and questions of freedom.

upcoming.title: Prima Facie
upcoming.plot: Tessa is a brilliant British defence barrister dominating London’s ruthless courtrooms. Fierce, witty, and self-made, she defends men accused of sexual assault — until she is assaulted herself by a colleague from a powerful legal dynasty.  Suddenly, the system she trusted turns against her. As she faces the same tactics she once used in court, Tessa’s faith in justice unravels. Once in control, now exposed and disbelieved, she must fight to reclaim her voice and sense of self.

upcoming.title: Paper Tiger
upcoming.plot: Two brothers chase the American dream, only to be pulled into the violent, corrupt world surrounding the Russian mafia. As their pursuit intensifies, danger and hard choices quickly close in.

upcoming.title: The Loneliest Man in Town
upcoming.plot: A reclusive blues musician lives alone in an apartment packed with memories while life outside moves on. When the building is marked for demolition, the looming loss forces him to face the past and rekindles a long-buried dream.

upcoming.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
upcoming.plot: A 16-year-old artist creates striking drawings and sculptures while facing a difficult effort to leave Iran and reunite with her mother in Austria. Strong-willed and determined, she pursues a safer future through her art and an uncertain journey.

kids.title: Coco
kids.plot: A young aspiring musician struggles against his family’s generations-old ban on music. After a mysterious turn of events takes him to the vibrant Land of the Dead, he teams up with a charming trickster on a journey to understand his family’s past and find a way home.

kids.title: Inside Out
kids.plot: When an 11-year-old moves to a new city, her emotions try to help her adjust to a life away from familiar friends and routines. After two of them become lost in the reaches of her mind, they must find their way back while the others try to manage the upheaval.

kids.title: The Nightmare Before Christmas
kids.plot: A weary Halloween figure discovers the wonders of Christmas and decides to bring the holiday’s cheer to a world built around scares. As the unusual plan takes shape, a thoughtful rag-doll companion worries about its consequences and tries to set things right.

kids.title: Forgotten Island
kids.plot: Two high school graduates and best friends are transported through a mysterious portal to a fantastical island filled with magical creatures. To find their way home, they must face a difficult cost tied to the memories that bind them, while seeking help and a way to leave before their friendship slips away.

kids.title: Coyote vs. Acme
kids.plot: After years of failed gadgets in his pursuit of a speedy bird, a determined coyote takes a bold new route: bringing the Acme Corporation to court. With help from a struggling lawyer, he faces a legal battle that mixes cartoon chaos with questions of fairness and corporate power.

kids.title: Toy Story 5
kids.plot: When a young girl becomes absorbed in a new tablet, her toys find it harder to hold her attention. The group faces a new challenge as they try to help her reconnect with playtime, navigating changing habits and the place technology has in a child’s life.

kids.title: Zootopia 2
kids.plot: After solving a major case, two rookie officers follow a new mystery that unsettles their animal-filled city. Their investigation takes them undercover into unfamiliar neighborhoods, where they must work through fresh challenges and test the strength of their partnership.

kids.title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
kids.plot: Two Brooklyn plumber brothers are transported through a mysterious pipe into a magical world, where they are separated. One brother sets off on a fast-moving quest to reunite with the other, encountering colorful new places and familiar challenges along the way.

kids.title: Tad and the Magic Lamp
kids.plot: An enthusiastic explorer accidentally unleashes an ancient spell, setting off a new adventure with his girlfriend and friends. Together, they face the consequences of the magic lamp while searching for a way to put things right.

kids.title: Minions & Monsters
kids.plot: A group of mischievous little creatures make their way into Hollywood and become movie stars, only to lose their success and unleash monsters through their filmmaking antics. With chaos spreading, they must work together to try to undo the trouble and save the planet.
